gaps.lead: It was unfair of the referee to send him off.
gaps.explanation: should(n't) have + participle criticises a past decision.
last did X in (year) = haven't done X since (year).

gaps.lead: The bad weather meant we couldn't leave the house.
Although he is remarkably rich, he lives very simply.
gaps.explanation: Although he may be rich → Rich as (he) may be — fronted adjective + as + may.

gaps.lead: It's pointless to worry about things you can't change.
gaps.sentence: There is ___ things you can't change.

gaps.lead: They say the new tunnel will halve journey times.
gaps.sentence: Journey times ___ by the new tunnel.
gaps.explanation: X is said to be + participle: reported statement, passive meaning.
